short: A direct connection to the earth usually made by driving copper rods into the earth and then connecting the ground wire of an electrical system to this point.
long: A direct connection to the earth usually made by driving copper rods into the earth and then connecting the ground wire of an electrical system to this point. The earth ground connection can serve as a common return path for the current in a circuit.

short: Circulating current induced in the iron core of an inductor by AC variations of magnetic flux.
long: Circulating current induced in the iron core of an inductor by AC variations of magnetic flux.

short: For sine-wave AC waveform, 0.707 of peak value.
long: For sine-wave AC waveform, 0.707 of peak value. Corresponds to heating effect of same DC value. Also called rms value.

short: Ratio of power output to power input × 100%.
long: Ratio of power output to power input × 100%.

long: Electronic Industries Alliance.

short: The invisible lines of force between opposite electric charges.
long: The invisible lines of force between opposite electric charges.

short: Dynamic electricity is the effect of voltage in producing current in conductors.
long: Dynamic electricity is the effect of voltage in producing current in conductors. Static electricity is accumulation of charge.

short: Solution that forms ion charges.
long: Solution that forms ion charges.

short: Type with very high C because electrolyte is used to form very thin dielectric.
long: Type with very high C because electrolyte is used to form very thin dielectric. Must be connected with correct polarity in a circuit.

short: Magnet whose magnetic field is associated with electric current in a coil.
long: Magnet whose magnetic field is associated with electric current in a coil.

short: Basic particle of negative charge in orbital rings around the nucleus in an atom.
long: Basic particle of negative charge in orbital rings around the nucleus in an atom.

short: Current of negative charges in motion.
long: Current of negative charges in motion. Direction is from the negative terminal of the voltage source, through the external circuit, and returning to the positive side of the source. Opposite to the direction of conventional current.

short: The creation of a free electron and a hole when a valence electron gains enough energy to leave its covalent bond in a silicon crystal.
long: The creation of a free electron and a hole when a valence electron gains enough energy to leave its covalent bond in a silicon crystal.

short: The number of electrons in an incomplete outermost shell of an atom.
long: The number of electrons in an incomplete outermost shell of an atom.

short: Unit of energy equal to the work done in moving a charge of 1 electron through a potential difference of 1 V.
long: Unit of energy equal to the work done in moving a charge of 1 electron through a potential difference of 1 V.

short: A substance that cannot be decomposed any further by chemical action.
long: A substance that cannot be decomposed any further by chemical action.

short: Electromotive force; voltage that produces current in a circuit.
long: Electromotive force; voltage that produces current in a circuit.

short: The most heavily doped region in a transistor.
long: The most heavily doped region in a transistor. Its job is to inject or emit current carriers into the base region.

short: A capacitor that bypasses the AC signal around the emitter resistor in a transistor amplifi er.
long: A capacitor that bypasses the AC signal around the emitter resistor in a transistor amplifi er.

short: Another name for the common-collector amplifi er.
long: Another name for the common-collector amplifi er.

short: A form of powers of 10 notation in which a number is expressed as a number between 1 and 1000 times a power of 10 that is a multiple of 3.
long: A form of powers of 10 notation in which a number is expressed as a number between 1 and 1000 times a power of 10 that is a multiple of 3.

short: The mode of operation for a MOSFET in which the polarity of VGS causes the conductivity of the channel to be enhanced, thus increasing the drain current.
long: The mode of operation for a MOSFET in which the polarity of VGS causes the conductivity of the channel to be enhanced, thus increasing the drain current.

short: In a parallel circuit this refers to a single resistance that would draw the same amount of current as all the parallel connected branches.
long: In a parallel circuit this refers to a single resistance that would draw the same amount of current as all the parallel connected branches.

short: A resistance in series with an ideal capacitor that collectively represents all of the losses in a capacitor.
long: A resistance in series with an ideal capacitor that collectively represents all of the losses in a capacitor. Ideally, the ESR of a capacitor should be zero.

short: A semiconductor that has been doped with impurity atoms to alter the characteristics of the material, mainly its conductivity.
long: A semiconductor that has been doped with impurity atoms to alter the characteristics of the material, mainly its conductivity.
